'''Christopher Kroutil''' (also published as '''Chris Kroutil'''; GEMP handle '''ckroutil''')<ref name="org2022">Email from Stephen Sanders to Retro League participants, 2026 (player name / GEMP handle / forum name list for 2022).</ref> is a player in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]. As Chris Kroutil he played Southern California and Las Vegas tournaments in 2001, including the [[2001 Vegas DPC]] and the [[2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open]].
